description: Gauges and bullets: a gauge is gaugeValue between gaugeMin and gaugeMax with gaugeRanges as the coloured bands behind the needle, gaugeTarget as a tick and gaugeUnit after the number, and animate sweeps the needle to a new value; a bullet chart is one row per category with the value as a bar, targets as a tick and bulletRanges as the qualitative bands behind every row. Free, in @svgrid/grid.

faq.question: How do I colour the gauge bands?
faq.answer: gaugeRanges is a list of { from, to, color } drawn behind the needle, in the order given. gaugeTarget adds a tick at that value.

faq.question: Does the needle animate?
faq.answer: Yes, with animate on the component: a change to gaugeValue sweeps the needle from the old value to the new one instead of jumping.

faq.question: What is a bullet chart for?
faq.answer: Several KPIs against their targets in little space: each row is a bar for the value, a tick for the target and shaded ranges behind it for poor, fair and good.
